 While the Friday after Thanksgiving has traditionally been the busiest shopping day of the year, Black Friday deals have gradually spread well beyond the day. First came Cyber Monday, then Cyber Week. Now, early Black Friday deals kick off before November has even started. The tricky part for early birds is knowing what’s a genuine deal and what’s likely to go even lower when Black Friday arrives.
 The Reviews team at WIRED tracks prices on our favorite gadgets year-round, and we only highlight deals on devices we've tested and would recommend to our own friends and family. Some of these picks may be cheaper for Black Friday, but these are the discounts that have caught our eye so far.
 Updated November 20: We've added new deals on an air fryer, a MagSafe wallet, and the Hatch Sleep clock. We also removed some lackluster deals and checked for accuracy throughout.

 Is Apple's gift card worth more than a store discount?
 Usually not. Apple's US terms give a $200 gift card with a MacBook Air (M5), $250 with a 14-inch MacBook Pro, $300 with a 16-inch MacBook Pro, $50 to $100 with an iPhone 17e, iPhone 16, iPhone 17 or iPhone Air (the Pro models are not included) and $125 with an iPad Pro.  For anything on the list above, buying during the Black Friday window carries little risk. Best Buy's Holiday Price Match Guarantee says that if the price of a product sold by Best Buy drops during the holiday season, it will match it, and Walmart and Best Buy both run separate Cyber Monday events afterwards. Black Friday Tech Deals

Black Friday tech deals are the electronics discounts that retailers such as Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart and Target run around Black Friday, the shopping day after US Thanksgiving. In 2026, Thanksgiving falls on Thursday, November 26, so Black Friday is Friday, November 27, and Cyber Monday is Monday, November 30. For the full calendar, store hours and every other category, start with our Black Friday 2026 guide.

However, a big red “sale” badge does not make a deal good. This guide therefore starts with where official tech deals are live right now, then covers what a genuinely good price looks like for TVs, laptops, Apple gear, headphones, tablets and smart home devices, which deals to skip, and how to track prices so you buy at the right moment. We quote deal prices only where the retailer itself published them, and list prices only where we checked them on the maker’s own site. Otherwise, use the “check today’s price” links and compare against the numbers below.

Which Black Friday tech deals start on November 19?

Three big Black Friday tech deals events start on Thursday, November 19. First, Amazon’s Black Friday Week opens at 12:01 a.m. PT and runs through Cyber Monday, November 30, according to Amazon’s November 9 first look; Amazon adds that its Today’s Big Deals will drop twice, at midnight and 8 a.m. PT, on Black Friday and Cyber Monday. Second, Best Buy’s 10-day Black Friday Doorbusters and Deals event begins the same day. Third, the Microsoft Store says its Black Friday sale runs November 19–28, although Microsoft had not revealed specific deals when we last checked.

Amazon’s preview also names its own devices: up to 35% off new models such as the Echo Show 16, Fire TV Stick 4K and Ring Pan-Tilt Indoor Cam 2K, and up to 45% off the Amazon Ember 55-inch Fire TV models and the Kindle Colorsoft (2024). However, Amazon has not announced Prime early access for Black Friday Week, so plan on the November 19 start like everyone else.

Pro tip. Amazon’s preview lists “up to” savings, not final prices. So before November 19, note the current price of the exact TV or laptop you want; then you can tell instantly whether the Black Friday price is a real cut.

When Do Black Friday Tech Deals Start in 2026?

Black Friday tech deals usually start weeks before the day itself, and the deepest prices arrive during Cyber Week, the five days from Thanksgiving through Cyber Monday (November 26–30, 2026). In fact, Adobe expects discounts of up to 14% in early November and up to 21% just before Thanksgiving, before the Cyber Week peak.

Amazon’s October Prime Day event already ran on October 6–7, 2026, with discounts that Adobe forecast to peak at 19% off list price. As a result, anything you missed then will probably reappear, often cheaper, in late November. This year, Amazon’s Black Friday Week starts November 19, one day earlier than Amazon’s 2025 Black Friday Week, which started November 20 and ran through Cyber Monday, December 1. Our Black Friday sale dates by store page tracks each retailer as announcements land.

Shoppers are also starting early. According to the National Retail Federation’s October 20 holiday survey, 43% of consumers planned to begin holiday shopping before November, yet 64% said they were likely to wait until Thanksgiving weekend for most of it. In addition, the NRF, the largest US retail trade group, forecast on October 15 that November–December retail sales will grow 4.2% to $1.013 trillion.

Are early Black Friday tech deals worth it?

Early Black Friday tech deals are worth it only when the price already matches the product’s historic low. Otherwise, Adobe’s forecast suggests waiting, since early-November discounts (up to 14%) are less than half the Cyber Week peak. That said, popular TV sizes and doorbuster laptops can sell out, so set price alerts now rather than refreshing pages on the day.

What Does a Good Black Friday Tech Deal Look Like?

A good Black Friday tech deal is a price at or below the product’s lowest recorded price, on a current model, from a retailer with a fair return policy. Percentages alone mislead, because the “original” price on the tag is the retailer’s choice.

Federal rules back this up. Specifically, the FTC’s Guides Against Deceptive Pricing say a former-price comparison is only legitimate when the item was really offered at that price for a reasonably substantial period. In practice, enforcement is uneven, so check the history yourself. Then use these benchmarks:

Electronics overall: about 30% off list is the forecast peak, so 30% or more on a current model is a strong deal.
TVs: about 23% off is the forecast peak, so judge older models against their own price history rather than the tag.
Laptops and computers: about 23% off is a solid benchmark.
Apple: any discount below the pre-June 2026 list price is notable (see the Apple section).

Pro tip. Before you buy, paste the exact model number into a search engine. If the only results are Black Friday ads, you are probably looking at a derivative model with no price history to compare.

Black Friday TV Deals: What to Expect

Black Friday TV deals are usually the strongest of the season on Black Friday itself; Adobe expects TV discounts to peak at about 23% off list price (versus 24.2% in 2025), with the best TV prices landing on November 27. So if a TV is your big purchase, Black Friday, not Cyber Monday, is the day to buy.

Costco has already posted the first official Black Friday TV prices of 2026. Its Black Friday page, checked November 10, lists the TCL 65-inch QM6K Pro at $499.99, TCL Q77L sets from $259.99 to $379.99 and the Hisense 100-inch QD7 at $999.99, valid November 27–30, while the Sony BRAVIA 6 OLED (55- and 65-inch) is already $999.99 to $1,199.99 online through November 30. However, Costco notes that valid dates vary by item, so recheck before you shop. Amazon, meanwhile, promises up to $600 off select Sony and Hisense TVs during its November 19–30 Black Friday Week, according to its November 9 announcement, but it has not published model-by-model prices yet.

What is the best time to buy a TV on Black Friday?

The best time to buy a TV is on Black Friday or in the days just before it, based on Adobe’s forecast. Still, it pays to keep watching afterward. Back in 2015, a Consumer Reports analysis cited by NBC News found about 40% of TVs were cheaper after Black Friday, so retailer price-adjustment windows matter.

Black Friday 4K TV deals: 65-inch sets

A 65-inch 4K TV is a popular size for living rooms, so it is worth planning the purchase carefully. First, decide between panel types: OLED offers perfect blacks, while Mini-LED and QLED sets get brighter for sunny rooms. Next, check the HDMI 2.1 port count if you game, then compare that exact model across retailers.

Are Black Friday TV deals worth it?

Yes, Black Friday TV deals are often worth it for established models, because TVs are one of the categories Adobe expects to be cheapest on that day. However, cheaper “derivative” models can look like bargains while quietly cutting features, which is the next section.

Which Black Friday Tech Deals Should You Skip?

Skip “derivative” TVs and laptops, unknown brands with no reviews, last-gen gear priced above the current model, and deals that are only cheap because of a fake “was” price. Each one looks like a bargain but often isn’t.

Derivative TVs are limited-run models with a slightly different model number, sometimes with fewer HDMI ports, cheaper parts or a slower panel. Because they are new, there are no reviews and no price history, and retailer price matching usually covers only identical models. Consumer Reports has called the practice a strategy that makes direct price comparisons harder, according to the NBC News report linked above. That said, some derivatives perform close to the regular model, so research the exact model before ruling it out.

Watch out. A doorbuster TV sold by only one retailer, in only one size, with zero reviews is a classic derivative red flag. Compare its spec sheet line by line with the regular model from the same brand.

How to Track Prices Before Black Friday

The easiest way to track prices before Black Friday is to set price-drop alerts now on Google and on an Amazon price-history tool, so you know the real low before the sales start. Here is a simple five-step routine:

1. Shortlist exact model numbers for each item you want, not just product names.
2. Set Google price alerts. Google’s Track price feature lets signed-in users track a product and optionally set a target price, with alerts by push notification and email.
3. Check Amazon price history with tools such as Keepa or CamelCamelCamel, which chart past Amazon prices and send drop alerts.
4. Compare retailers on the same model number, including Best Buy, Walmart and Target, and add shipping costs.
5. Know the return and price-adjustment rules. Retailers often extend holiday return windows. Best Buy says most purchases made October 30 through December 31, 2026 can be returned through January 15, 2027 (January 31 for My Best Buy Plus and Total members), and its Holiday Price Match Guarantee excludes Marketplace items. Target’s holiday FAQ gives purchases made November 1 to December 24, 2026 extra time: most electronics must be back by January 24, 2027, and Apple, Beats and mobile phones by January 8, 2027. The Microsoft Store accepts eligible physical products bought October 1 to December 2, 2026 through January 31, 2027. Apple Store purchases received November 6 to December 25, 2026 can be returned through January 8, 2027, according to Apple’s returns policy as reported by MacRumors. Walmart had not posted its 2026 holiday return terms on its own site as of November 10, 2026, so confirm the official terms before relying on them.

Pro tip. If a price drops after you buy, ask the retailer about a price adjustment within its policy window before returning the item. It is faster than a return and rebuy, and you keep the product.

Electronics and computers, meanwhile, are forecast to bottom out on Cyber Monday, so read our Cyber Monday 2026 guide before deciding which day to buy.

Our verdict

The best Black Friday tech deals in 2026 reward preparation, not speed. Best Buy and Costco deals are already live, Walmart follows on November 12, and Amazon, Best Buy and the Microsoft Store start their main events on November 19. Buy TVs on Black Friday, wait until Cyber Monday for laptops, headphones and most other electronics, and treat any discount of 30% or more on a current, well-reviewed model as a strong deal. For Apple, remember that June’s price increases reset the baseline, so compare with both the current and the old list price, and check education pricing first if you are a student.

Above all, set price alerts now, skip unknown derivative models, and compare exact model numbers across stores. That way, when the November 27 rush starts, you will know a real bargain the moment you see it.

Frequently Asked Questions
When do Black Friday tech deals start in 2026?

Black Friday tech deals have already started. Best Buy Early Black Friday Deals began November 6, 2026, and Costco holiday savings run through November 15. Walmart Early Black Friday Deals start November 12, and Amazon Black Friday Week, the Best Buy Black Friday Doorbusters and the Microsoft Store sale all start November 19. Apple has not announced its 2026 Black Friday event.

What is the best time to buy a TV on Black Friday?

The best time to buy a TV is on Black Friday itself, November 27, 2026. Adobe forecasts TV discounts peaking at about 23 percent off list price on that day. Even so, keep tracking the price afterward, since some models get cheaper later, and use the retailer price-adjustment policy if the price drops within the window.

Are Black Friday TV deals worth it?

Black Friday TV deals are usually worth it for established, well-reviewed models, because TVs are among the categories expected to hit their lowest prices that day. However, avoid unfamiliar derivative models sold by a single retailer with no reviews, since they may cut features such as HDMI ports and have no price history to compare.

Will AirPods be on sale for Black Friday 2026?

AirPods are likely to be discounted by third-party retailers such as Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart and Target, although no 2026 AirPods deal has been announced yet. Apple itself rarely cuts prices. Compare any offer with Apple list prices of 129 dollars for AirPods 5, 249 dollars for AirPods Pro 3 and 549 dollars for AirPods Max 2.

What are the best Black Friday laptop deals for students?

The best Black Friday laptop deals for students are often on entry Macs and mid-range Windows laptops with 16GB of RAM. Check education pricing first: on October 24, 2026, Apple listed the MacBook Neo from 599 dollars and the M5 MacBook Air from 1,199 dollars for students. A Black Friday deal only helps if it beats those prices.

Is it better to buy tech on Black Friday or Cyber Monday?

It depends on the product. Adobe expects the best TV prices on Black Friday, November 27, and the deepest discounts on electronics and computers on Cyber Monday, November 30, 2026. So buy TVs on Friday and wait until Monday for laptops, headphones and tablets, unless a historic-low price appears earlier.

Shoppers are moving early, too. According to the NRF’s October 20 holiday survey, 43% of consumers planned to start holiday shopping before November, although 64% expect to wait until Thanksgiving weekend for most of their purchases. More recently, the NRF’s November 19 projection says 182.7 million people plan to shop over Thanksgiving weekend, down slightly from the 186.9 million it projected last year, and 69% of holiday shoppers (126 million) plan to shop on Black Friday itself. Most Black Friday ads come out between late October and mid-November, but the first Black Friday ads 2026 arrived earlier. Black Friday ads often leak a few days to a week before a store makes them official, usually when deal-tracking sites post scans of the circular. For instance, 9to5Toys published Costco’s full 2025 ad on October 25, and it posted Home Depot’s ad on November 5, before Home Depot had settled its final dates. Are Black Friday tech sales good this year? Where to shop first 
 Skip to main content 
 Advertisement
 Advertisement
 Advertisement
 Some of the biggest Black Friday tech sales of the season are currently live. If a new laptop, TV, pair of headphones or Apple device is on your holiday shopping list, you don't necessarily need to wait until Nov. 27 .
 Black Friday tech deals are already heating up at Amazon, Best Buy, Target, Walmart and Samsung. We compared the biggest sales to help you decide where to shop first. 
 Amazon and Best Buy officially kicked off their Black Friday events on Nov. 19, and we're already seeing some major discounts across some of the most popular tech categories. 
 Apple AirPods Pro 3 are already down to $179 from $249 at multiple retailers, while Amazon has the M5 13-inch MacBook Air around $1,049, a $250 discount.
 Advertisement
 Advertisement
 So, are Black Friday tech sales actually good this year?
 My answer right now is yes, but you shouldn't shop every retailer the same way. Certain stores are emerging as particularly good destinations depending on whether you're buying Apple products, TVs, gaming gear or smart home devices. Here's where I'd start.
 1. Amazon: Best overall place to start comparing tech deals
 Apple AirPods Pro 3 Wireless Earbuds 
 If you only have time to check one Black Friday tech sale today, I'd start with Amazon.
 Amazon's Black Friday Week is officially live through Cyber Monday, Nov. 30. The retailer says there will be millions of deals across tech, toys, home, fashion and other categories, including savings from Samsung, Bose and Anker.
 Advertisement
 Advertisement
 Apple is one of the biggest reasons to check Amazon first this year. Current deals include:
 Apple AirPods Pro 3 : $179, down from $249
 Apple AirTag (2nd Generation) 4-Pack : $79.99, down from $99
 Apple iPad Mini A17 Pro: $484, down from $599
 Apple MacBook Air 13-Inch with M5 : $1,049, down from $1,299
 Apple 2026 MacBook Neo 13-Inch Laptop : $649, down from $699
 Shop Amazon's Black Friday tech deals 
 2. Best Buy: Best Black Friday sale for TVs, laptops and big-ticket tech
 For bigger electronics, I'd make Best Buy your second stop, or even your first if you're shopping specifically for a television or computer.
 Best Buy's main Black Friday event began Nov. 19 with 10 days of deals and Doorbusters. Current offers span TVs, laptops, Apple products, headphones and other electronics.
 Advertisement
 Advertisement
 Some of the early standouts include up to $40 off select EA Sports video games , a TCL 65-inch TV for $229.99 , an HP OmniBook 5 OLED laptop for $449.99 and Sony noise-canceling headphones for $169 . 
 Shop Best Buy's Black Friday tech deals 
 3. Target: Best for tech gifts and easy holiday shopping
 Target is one of my favorite places to watch if you're not necessarily shopping for a $1,000 laptop, but rather tech gifts people actually want to unwrap.
 Shop Target's best Black Friday tech deals on headphones, TVs and even popular toys like the Nex Playground. 
 The retailer has been running holiday Deal of the Day promotions since Nov. 1 and is expected to offer additional Black Friday and Cyber Monday savings.
 We're already seeing Target compete directly with Amazon and Best Buy on some popular products . For example, the same Ring Battery Doorbell 2K was recently selling for $40 at Target, Best Buy and Amazon , while the Sony DualSense controller was as low as $54.99 at Target , Best Buy and Amazon. Here are some of the best tech gifts on sale at Target:

 Shop Target's Black Friday tech deals

 4. Costco: Worth checking before buying expensive tech
 Costco isn't necessarily the first retailer that comes to mind for Black Friday tech, but members shouldn't skip it .
 Its holiday savings events are running in stages throughout November, with additional Black Friday offers scheduled for Nov. 27 through Nov. 30.
 For expensive electronics, it's worth comparing Costco's total package, rather than looking only at the sticker price. Bundles, included accessories or other member benefits can sometimes make a deal more attractive even when another retailer advertises a similar base price.

 5. Samsung: Best for Galaxy devices and premium TVs
 Save on Galaxy smartphones, tablets and watches, OLED and QLED TVs, The Frame TVs, monitors and other premium Samsung electronics. 
 If a new phone, tablet, monitor or TV is on your Black Friday list, don't overlook shopping directly from Samsung .

 Advertisement

 TVs are a particularly important category to comparison-shop this year. Current Black Friday coverage is already surfacing discounts on models like the 55-inch Samsung The Frame for $600 off , showing that Samsung TVs are firmly in the early Black Friday deal mix.
 Shop Samsung Black Friday tech deals

 6. Walmart: The retailer I'd watch for aggressive Black Friday pricing
 Black Friday isn't just a day anymore. Walmart's holiday sales calendar includes early Black Friday, Black Friday and Cyber Monday events packed with deal opportunities. 
 Walmart's main Black Friday Deals event starts online Nov. 23 and runs through Nov. 29 , with the in-store event beginning Nov. 27. Its Cyber Monday event follows Nov. 30 through Dec. 2.

 That makes Walmart particularly interesting right now because its biggest event hasn't started yet.
 Even before that sale, Walmart is competing on high-interest Black Friday tech. AirPods Pro 3 are already $179 there , matching Amazon's current price. You can already find thousands of tech deals at Walmart across TVs, headphones, laptops and more.

 Historically popular Black Friday tech categories are also among the most competitive this year. Based on the deals currently surfacing across major retailers, I'd prioritize:

 Black Friday 2026 — what you need to know 
 When is Black Friday 2026? 
 The actual Black Friday date changes every year, but this year's Black Friday is November 27, 2026. However, Black Friday has become much more than just a single day. Retailers started offering early deals in October and the trend has continued. Likewise, Black Friday won’t end when November 27 draws to a close. Plenty of the best deals will stretch into the weekend as retailers gear up for Cyber Monday (Nov. 30.)
 When to start looking for Black Friday deals? 
 Retailers have been offering their Black Friday deals earlier than ever, and we're continuing to see stock levels remain high during the big day today. If anything we expect to see more steep discounts in the coming days towards Cyber Monday .
 Sometimes Apple devices, OLED TVs, gaming laptops and more are cheaper in the runup to Black Friday than they are on the day itself, so don’t assume that waiting is always the best strategy. If you see a deal you like, grab it now or you may regret it.
 It’s also important to remember that it’s not uncommon for stock issues to plague Black Friday, especially on the most popular items. So if you take advantage of early deals you’re not only in with a shot of getting a deal that matches or beats the final Black Friday price, but you’ll also avoid the chaos that comes with the day itself.
 How to find the best Black Friday deals?  
 The obvious answer is to stick with Tom’s Guide as we’ll be updating this page regularly as we approach Black Friday 2026. We’ll also have in-depth coverage across every major product category from TVs to running shoes. We’re here every single day before, during and after Black Friday to ensure that you never miss a lowest price ever discount or an epic deal.
 Alongside regularly checking our Black Friday coverage, it helps to be diligent and do your research. If you’re in the market for a particular product, be sure to check prices across multiple retailers. Don’t just assume Amazon is giving you the best deal check the likes of Walmart, Best Buy, Target and more before clicking "buy now."
 It also helps to know the price history of an item so you can check you're getting a real deal rather than a fake discount. Tools like CamelCamelCamel are especially useful when checking what a product has sold for in the past and figuring out the best deals.
 Who will offer the best Black Friday deals in 2026?
 Every retailer has Black Friday deals available. However, if you're wondering who has the best Black Friday deals — the answer varies based on what you want to buy. For instance, Amazon, Best Buy, and Walmart tend to dominate when it comes to deals on 4K TVs, laptops and smartwatches.
 For deals on apparel and home goods, we recommend turning to stores like Macy's, Wayfair, and Bed Bath & Beyond. Home goods is a broad topic and also includes mattresses. If you're shopping for the latter, mattress manufacturers tend to offer the best and biggest discounts, oftentimes undercutting box retailers.
 What is Black Friday?
 Black Friday is a retail holiday that's held on the Friday after Thanksgiving. Retailers typically hold sales and offer their best discounts of the year on or around Black Friday. This is because it marks the start of the holiday shopping period, when buyers start looking for holiday gifts. Black Friday is a great time to shop for tech, apparel, toys, home decor, or anything you need to buy.
 How long does Black Friday last?
 Although it's called Black Friday, sales will typically extend beyond the day itself. Early Black Friday deals will start days or weeks ahead of time at most retailers like Amazon, Best Buy and Walmart. After Black Friday, many sales will continue through the weekend and the week afterwards. However, be cautious about waiting too long to make a purchase — popular Black Friday sales can sell out in a matter of seconds.
 What is the difference between Black Friday and Cyber Monday?
 In the past, brick-and-mortar stores would hold their biggest sales of the year on Black Friday. Then, online retailers would get in on the action and hold their best sales on the following Monday — hence the name Cyber Monday. However, over time, customers have turned towards online shopping en masse. Most retailers release their offering of deals online and in store at the same time, causing the distinction between Black Friday and Cyber Monday to blur.
 Even if you're planning to make your purchases online, I recommend being ready to do so on Black Friday itself as opposed to Cyber Monday. This gives you the best chance of securing the items you want before they sell out.
 Black Friday deals and games consoles
 Buying consoles should be easy enough this year. Gone are the days of hunting for restock of the Xbox Series X, PS5 and Nintendo Switch 2.
 However, there are price raises to contend with. Xbox, PlayStation and Nintendo consoles have all seen price increases this year. If we're lucky, Black Friday deals could knock prices back down a little. Failing that, discounts will most likely be available via bundles. For example, the Nintendo Switch 2 Mario Kart World bundle gets you a console with a game for $37 less than it would cost to buy everything separately.
 Games consoles are bound to be some of the most popular deals available on Black Friday — so if you see a good discount, act fast.
 Why is it called Black Friday? 
 (Image credit: Shutterstock) The use of the term "Black Friday" to describe the retail holiday dates back to 1961 in Philadelphia. It was used to describe the crowded pedestrian and vehicle traffic that resulted the day after Thanksgiving. By 1975, the term had gained traction and was being used outside of Philadelphia.
 These days, retailers have a different explanation for the term. For many companies, Black Friday marks the point in the calendar year when companies go "in the black," or finally begin to turn a profit for the year. The profit they make is due to the surge in shoppers looking for holiday deals.
 Does Apple do Black Friday?
 Retailers like Amazon, Best Buy and Walmart offer epic discounts on Apple products on Black Friday. And if you're looking for iPhone deals, head to carriers like AT&T or Verizon for the chance to get cheap plans and trade-in discounts.
 However, you're unlikely to see discounted items at the Apple Store on Black Friday. Instead, Apple usually offers gift cards with purchase of their products. In the past, Apple gave $200 gift cards with the purchase of the MacBook Air and Mac Mini. $100 gift cards were up for grabs when buying select iPad models and $75 gift cards were given with iPhone and AirPods purchases.

Amazon Black Friday and Cyber Monday 2026: best deals and drops 
 Black Friday and Cyber Monday 2026: a first look at Amazon’s best deals
 Millions of deals across electronics, beauty, fashion, toys, and more drop November 19 through November 30, with new daily themed deals and double drops on Black Friday and Cyber Monday.
 Share 
 Written by Jacquelyn Smith 
 Published: November 09, 2026 
 9 min read
 Key takeaways
 Amazon’s Black Friday Week and Cyber Monday deal events run November 19 through November 30, with millions of deals across popular categories and new daily themed deal drops—spanning toys, tech, fashion, beauty, premium gifts, and stocking stuffers. 
 For the first time, Today’s Big Deals will feature savings of up to 60% off, dropping twice on Black Friday and Cyber Monday—at midnight and 8 a.m. PST. 
 Customers can save on holiday feasts with Same-Day Delivery on fresh groceries in more than 2,300 cities . 
 The biggest holiday shopping moment of the year is almost here. Amazon’s Black Friday Week and Cyber Monday deal events will kick off on November 19, featuring millions of deals across electronics, beauty, fashion, toys, home, and more from brands like medicube, Le Creuset, HP, Google, and Stanley. 
 Amazon's Holiday Kids Gift Book is back with 600+ toys, games, and gifts for every age
 From an interactive Alexa+ story to exclusive Forest Friends gifts, this year's edition has something for everyone on your list.
 This year’s event will also feature more Amazon Exclusives in the Holiday Shop than ever before, including Swarovski jewelry, Caraway cookware sets, and exclusive colorways including necklaces from Spicy Dan and the NAADAM Originals cashmere crewneck in medium blue. This year, customers can save even more with Today’s Big Deals daily themed deal drops throughout the events, featuring brands like Theragun, Balsam Hill, Frye & Co., and HydroJug. And for the first time ever, limited-time deals of up to 60% off will drop at midnight and 8 a.m. PST on both Black Friday and Cyber Monday. 
 Here’s a look at some of the best deals to expect—and all the ways to save. 
 All deals and availability are subject to change. 
 When does Black Friday start on Amazon?
 Amazon’s Black Friday Week and Cyber Monday deal events kick off at 12:01 a.m. PST on November 19 and run through November 30. New daily themed deal drops launch throughout the events, with double drops on Black Friday and Cyber Monday at midnight and 8 a.m. PST. 
 What are the best Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals on Amazon?
 Amazon devices: Save up to 35% on Amazon’s all-new devices , including the Alexa Photo Frame ; Amazon Alexa Tablet 8, 11, and 12 Pro ; Amazon Kids Tablet 8 and 11 ; Echo Show 16; Echo Time and Amazon Kids Echo Time ; Fire TV Stick 4K ; and Ring Pan-Tilt Indoor Cam 2K . Plus, save up to 45% on the Amazon Ember 55” Artline with Fire TV , Amazon Ember 55” Mini-LED Series with Fire TV, and Kindle Colorsoft (2024). 
 Amazon Business: Save up to 50% on deals exclusive to business customers, including Mr. Pen-Plastic Pencil Case Box, 24 Pack and Mr. Pen-Pencil Top Erasers, 120 Pack. 
 Amazon Autos: There’s never been a better time to find your next ride. From Thursday, November 12, through Monday, November 30, eligible Prime members who buy or lease a new car on Amazon Autos get a $1,500 Amazon.com gift card—just in time for holiday shopping. 
 Amazon Music: For a limited time, customers who haven’t tried Amazon Music Unlimited can get three months free. Additionally, current Amazon Music Unlimited Individual Plan customers can upgrade to a Family Plan at no extra cost for two months. Amazon Music Unlimited has more than 100 million songs and top podcasts available on demand in high-quality streaming audio. The service also includes the world’s largest collection of audiobooks from Audible , with one audiobook a month included. Learn more about Amazon Music Unlimited . Terms apply. 
 11 Amazon AI features to help you find the best deals this holiday season
 This holiday season, these AI shopping tools can help you find, track, and score great deals on everything on your list.
 Score up to 40% off select music merchandise this holiday season. Prime members shopping for music apparel, CDs, and vinyl can unlock deals on Amazon.com or in the Amazon Music app. 
 Save on select items from KATSEYE, Sam Smith, and more. 
 Electronics: 
 Save up to $600 on select TVs from Sony and Hisense 
 Save up to 50% on select headphones and speakers from Beats, JBL, Marshall and Sonos 
 Save up to 30% on select laptops and gaming PCs from ASUS, ACER, Alienware, Lenovo, and HP 
 Beauty: 
 Save up to 40% on select beauty from medicube and Color Wow 
 Save up to 40% on select beauty from ANUA and REDKEN 
 Save up to 30% on skincare and body care favorites from OLAY, First Aid Beauty, Native, Mario Badescu, and Cremo 
 Save up to 30% on makeup from Revolution Beauty London, KIKO Milano and Maybelline 
 Save up to $90 on select beauty tools and devices from ghd and Braun 
 Fashion: 
 Save up to 50% on select apparel and shoes from Calvin Klein, Skechers, and Guess 
 Save up to 30% on select styles from Under Armour and Fossil 
 Save up to 30% on cozy outerwear and pajamas from Amazon Essentials 
 Save up to 30% on select Shopbop styles from brands including Levi’s, Vans, Lioness, Dr. Martens, Veja, Madewell, and Free People. 
 Save up to 60% on select Zappos products including Crocs, Arc’teryx, PAWZ, Vionic, Hunter Kids, and Eberjey. 
 Toys: 
 Save up to 50% on select arts and crafts from Crayola and Melissa & Doug 
 Save up to 45% on select toys from NERF, Play-Doh, MAGNA-TILES, and Mattel 
 Save up to 30% on select toys from Barbie and Hot Wheels, plus select games from Ravensburger 
 Home and kitchen: 
 Save up to 45% on select holiday chocolate and candy from Hershey’s Kisses, Lindt, Ferrero Rocher, and Chupa Chups 
 Save up to 40% on select Ninja appliances, including the Ninja EverSear, Ninja CREAMi, Ninja SLUSHi, and Ninja FOODi 
 Save up to 40% on select cookware from Our Place and Farberware 
 Save up to 40% on select candles from Yankee Candle 
 Save up to 40% on select bath and laundry essentials from Lands’ End and Madison Park 
 Save up to 45% on select coffee makers from Keurig 
 Save up to 40% on select floorcare from iRobot and Bissell 
 Save up to 30% on select entertaining and dining essentials from YETI and Solo Stove 
 Save up to 30% on select bedding from UGG and Laura Ashley 
 Save up to 25% on select bakeware from Pyrex, OXO, King Arthur, and All-Clad 
 Save more than $200 on select espresso machines from Breville 
 Save up to $80 on select air purifiers from Levoit 
 Seasonal décor: 
 Save up to $500 on select artificial Christmas trees from Balsam Hill and Fraser Hill Farm 
 Save up to 35% on select curtains and home textiles from Lush Decor 
 Save up to 35% on select ornaments and holiday tabletop from Lenox 
 Save up to 30% on select holiday cards, gift wrap, and ornaments from Hallmark 
 Books: Get three months free of Kindle+ and explore millions of included eBooks and audiobooks to read or listen to over the holidays, such as Peculiar Stars , the highly anticipated castaway romance novel by Rebecca Yarros. Terms and conditions apply. 
 Save on top Kindle picks, including 90% off Before the Coffee Gets Cold (digital book set) by Toshikazu Kawaguchi and 80% off Game Changer by Rachel Reid 
 Save on trending print picks from Amazon Editors, including 60% off Strangers by Belle Burden, 55% off Kin by Tayari Jones, and 50% off Yesteryear by Caro Claire Burke 
 Stocking stuffers: Find deals under $5 across categories—perfect for filling stockings without stretching your budget. 
 What daily deal drops can you expect?
 Today’s Big Deals will feature 12 days of daily themed deal drops—spanning toys, tech, fashion, beauty, premium gifts, and stocking stuffers, with savings up to 60% off. For the first time ever, deals will drop twice on both Black Friday and Cyber Monday at midnight and 8 a.m. PST. This year’s lineup includes fan favorites from Theragun, Balsam Hill, Frye & Co., and HydroJug. Deals are available only while supplies last; customers will want to check back daily for the latest offers across the season’s most-wanted brands and products. 
 What Thanksgiving grocery deals does Amazon offer?
 Customers can shop fresh groceries and everyday essentials right alongside gifts and décor, all in one cart. With Amazon Grocery available in more than 2,300 cities and towns with Same-Day Delivery, getting a full holiday meal to your door within hours has never been easier. 
 Customers can get everything they need for a complete Thanksgiving meal at unbeatable prices. Frozen turkeys start as low as $0.79 per pound (November 1–26) and fresh turkeys at $0.99 per pound (November 14–26), with Thanksgiving staples priced under $4 to round out the holiday spread without stretching the budget. Customers can also save up to 40% off charcuterie and party snacks (November 2–14) and pre-made sides (November 15–26). 
 Amazon Haul’s early Haul-iday deals event: $1 flash deals, $0.11 steals, and millions of items under $10
 From November 9–14, customers can score ultra-low prices across fashion, beauty, home, electronics, and more from Amazon Haul.
 What about Amazon Haul deals?
 Shop Amazon Haul’s early Haul-iday deals event November 9–14, featuring $1 flash deals all week and $0.11 deals on November 10–11. The savings keep going in the lead-up to Black Friday and Cyber Monday with deals across holiday décor, stocking stuffers, and seasonal apparel and accessories. 
 What live sports are on Prime Video during Black Friday Week?
 Prime Video is delivering a stacked lineup of live sports throughout Black Friday Week, with no subscription or Prime membership required. Coverage tees off at 6 a.m. PST: 
 Wednesday, November 25: Duke Blue Devils vs. UConn Huskies—Prime Video’s first-ever NCAA basketball game (4 p.m. PST) 
 Black Friday: Coverage starts at 6 a.m. PST with the Farmers Insurance Skins Game , followed by the fourth annual Black Friday Football game featuring the Pittsburgh Steelers hosting the Denver Broncos, and an NBA on Prime doubleheader (Miami Heat vs. New York Knicks, then Los Angeles Lakers vs. San Antonio Spurs) 
 Fans can watch and shop simultaneously with the “Shop the Game” experience—press “up” on your remote or search “shop the game” in the Amazon Shopping app to find great deals featured in the broadcasts, and official NFL, NBA, and NCAA merchandise. 
 How can you find the best deals during Amazon’s Black Friday event?
 Alexa for Shopping can do the deal hunting for you, surfacing relevant deals, tracking prices, and keeping you informed so you never miss a savings opportunity. 
 Watch for deals and price drops: Ask Alexa for Shopping to monitor items you’re eyeing. Set up with auto-buy , it can even complete the purchase for you when the price is right. 
 See up to a year of price history: Tap “ Price history ” on any product page, or ask Alexa for Shopping, to view up to 365 days of pricing data. 
 Build and manage holiday lists with your voice: Create Wish Lists , organize a registry, or move items between lists—all by asking. Tap the heart icon on any product to save it, then set deal alerts on your lists page. 
 Get more done with just a conversation: Alexa for Shopping can now handle more than 100 everyday shopping actions through simple conversation. Beyond lists, it can also help with everyday account tasks like adjusting Subscribe & Save deliveries, checking your gift card balance, tracking refunds, updating delivery instructions, and staying on top of your Prime and Audible memberships. 
 What other Amazon holiday deals and savings are available?
 Browse the Holiday Shop: Find the perfect gift with Top 100 lists, curated gift guides organized by recipient, price point, and interest, the annual Top 100+ Toys list , and the Holiday Kids Gift Book —all in one place at Amazon Holiday Shop . This year, the Holiday Shop delivers a fully personalized experience, surfacing gift recommendations based on customers’ shopping history, preferences, and family needs so the most relevant ideas appear first. Explore holiday gift picks curated by popular creators like Alix Earle , Brigette McHale , Rochelle Stewart , Preston Konrad and Dad Social 
 through their Amazon Storefronts. 
 Send a gift card that stands out: Amazon’s new personalized digital gift cards offer customers a fun, creative, and convenient way to make gifting personal during the year’s busiest shopping season. Customers can choose a new way to add a personal touch: with Talking Pets, customers upload a photo of their pet and bring it to life to deliver a holiday greeting—making every card as unique as the person sending it. Available just in time for Black Friday and Cyber Monday, this feature turns a routine gift card into a memorable moment. 
 Shop small businesses: More than 60% of sales in Amazon’s store come from independent sellers , most of which are small and medium-sized businesses. Save big on home, health, beauty, and fitness products from U.S.-based small businesses, including up to 65% off BLITZU, 65% off The Beard Club grooming products, 55% off Comfy Cubs baby products, up to 30% off SMIRLY kitchen products, and 40% off Solawave Red Light Therapy Wands. Shoppers can also ask Alexa for Shopping to “shop small businesses” to find small businesses in Amazon’s store, or look for the Small Business badge. 
 Play 80-plus games with Amazon Luna—included with Prime: This holiday season, dive into an evolving library of more than 80 games included with Prime at no additional cost. Play everything from blockbuster titles like STAR WARS: Galactic Racer , Tomb Raider , and EA SPORTS Madden NFL 26 to family favorites like Game of Life 2 and Cranium Planet . Visit Amazon Luna to start playing. 
 Save on travel: Score up to $1,000 off vacations with Royal Caribbean, up to 50% off select hotels and stays through Hotels.com and Expedia, and up to 30% off car rentals from Avis and Budget. Plus, earn up to 15% back as an Amazon gift card. 
 Earn more with Prime Visa and Prime Store Card: Get a $200 Amazon gift card instantly upon approval for Prime Visa (November 5 to January 7, 2027) or $100 for Prime Store Card (November 22–30). Prime cardmembers can earn 10% back or more on select, limited-time deals on top brands and categories with Prime Card Bonus, unlimited 5% back year-round at Amazon.com, Whole Foods Market (in-store code required for Prime Store Card), and more—all with no annual credit card fee. 
 Prime for Young Adults exclusive: On November 24 only, Prime for Young Adults members can unlock exclusive 20% cash back on a selection of trending products across beauty, apparel, electronics, and more—available while supplies last. That’s four times the everyday 5% cash back, and it can be combined with eligible Black Friday Week and Cyber Monday deals for even deeper savings. 
 Unlock discounts on Prime Video: Prime members can save up to 75% on a selection of new and popular titles to rent or buy, and all Amazon customers can access up to 75% off select subscriptions and bundles. Check out all the Prime Video deals. 
 Amazon’s 2026 Top 100+ Toys list: Something for every kid at heart
 From budget-friendly finds and Amazon exclusives to trending collectibles, sensory toys, and screen-free favorites, the annual list for 2026 spotlights 100+ expert-curated toys to make holiday gifting easier.
 How do I join Prime before Black Friday?
 Anyone can join Prime for $14.99 a month or $139 a year, or start a free 30-day trial , if eligible. Young adults (ages 18–24) and college students can try Prime for Young Adults with a six-month free trial, then pay $7.49 a month or $69 a year.  You don’t need a calendar full of sale dates to navigate the shopping frenzy. Focus on the categories likely to offer the biggest savings . Here’s what to buy, and what can wait.
 Buy: Must-have toys
 If you’ve got top-priority toys on your list, buy them at a discount if you can find them, says Kristin McGrath, senior editor at The Krazy Coupon Lady, “just in case they don’t go down in price later.”
 Non-electronic toys are a good bet, says Julie Ramhold, consumer analyst with DealNews.com, because they’re less affected by tariffs on electronic components. That includes Legos, dolls and playsets.
 NeeDoh squishies are a hot stocking stuffer this year and may be in short supply. At authorized retailers like Target, they should be relatively affordable, but try to avoid unauthorized resellers who may crank up the price, Ramhold says.
 Skip: Mattresses and bedding
 While you may see mattress stores offering a few doorbusters on Black Friday, don’t feel pressured to jump on a deal.
 “Mattresses tend to see some of their strongest discounts around major sales events like Labor Day and Presidents Day,” says Ashley Feinstein Gerstley, shopping and savings strategist with Rakuten. “So if you’re not in a rush, it may be worth waiting for one of those windows.”
 Similarly, bedding and towels are often on deep discount during January white sales, Feinstein Gerstley says.

 Buy: Small appliances
 Got some counter space and an itch for a new food processor? Black Friday sales are a great time to price surf for countertop appliances, including blenders, juicers and air fryers.
 “Those things we see sometimes half off or more,” McGrath says. “And they’re all on sale at the same time, so any one you’re looking for is likely to have a discount.”
 Skip: Holiday decor
 Holiday decor is only a must-buy during Black Friday sales if you need it for this holiday season.
 While you’ll still see sales on holiday items like artificial trees, drinkware and garlands, “if you can wait until after Christmas, that’s when discounts should reach up to 80% or more at stores like Target, Walmart and department stores like JCPenney and Macy’s,” Ramhold says.
 Buy (with care): TVs, laptops, gaming consoles
 Electronics are typically a slam-dunk buy at this time of year. “Every store is competing for your business, so televisions , headphones, tablets, laptops — they’re all going to be on sale at the same time,” McGrath says.
 Gaming consoles, in particular, see some of the better discounts. And they often come bundled with a gift card, gaming accessories or video games. “Consoles are common gifts,” McGrath says. “The stores know that, so they’re offering competitive deals.”
 That said, the traditional deep discounts you usually see on electronics for Black Friday may be a little lackluster this year due to high prices on parts, Ramhold says.
 For best results, research the exact specs of the product you want and put it in your cart ahead of time, says consumer savings expert Andrea Woroch. That way, if a similar (but not identical) product goes on sale, you won’t accidentally buy the wrong thing.
 Skip: Fitness equipment and activewear
 You’ll usually find deeper discounts on items that are associated with fitness resolutions after New Year’s Day.
 “Big-box retailers like Target and department stores like Macy’s will offer up to 40% off or more on both fitness equipment and activewear during early January sales,” Ramhold says.
 Buy: Clothes
 Many fashion retailers offer Black Friday sales, McGrath says. So if there’s an item you stock in multiple colors or a work staple you need to replace, keep an eye on your favorite sites for the markdowns.
 Shoes, too, are a category to eyeball, including seasonal buys and everyday options like running shoes, Ramhold says. “Some retailers may offer a BOGO promotion of some kind, but it’ll likely just be a ‘buy one, get one for 50% off,’” she says.
 Just shop early for your size and color before inventory runs low, McGrath says. “You don’t want to miss out if there's a great deal.”
 One caveat: Winter apparel will usually see bigger discounts toward the end of the year, Woroch says. So wait on your boot and coat purchases if you can.

 Plan before you buy
 Black Friday deals are as much about strategy as savings, so make sure you’re maximizing your spending with these tips:
 Let AI help. Tools like ChatGPT and Gemini can do a lot of the legwork for you. Write out a product name and try prompts like “Find the lowest price for X product by comparing every retail site that it’s sold on and including coupons and cash back offers,” Woroch says. (Just note that AI searches can be limited and may not find every deal available.)
 Check the price, not just the percentage: “Sometimes the base price is inflated or it was listed initially for a higher price,” Feinstein Gerstley says. “Another retailer might have the same item for less, even if their discount doesn't look as impressive.”
